feeds.title: The Retail Doctor Blog
feeds.description: Bob Phibbs is The Retail Doctor - helping make retailers smarter, more competitive and more profitable since 1994. He provides a wealth of information on everything from employee training and retention, making your store events a success, and lessons retailers can learn from the success and failures of other businesses.

feeds.title: Tinuiti Blog
feeds.description: Explore our digital marketing blog for the latest digital marketing insights & resources. Stay on top of current hot topics with Tinuiti today. Tinuiti unites channel expertise with a cross-channel strategy to help clients identify, engage, and acquire customers, then retain and reactivate them as they continue their digital journey.

feeds.title: Retailgeek Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about how we shop, what makes a great retail experience online or in-store, and how retailers occasionally fall short. It's also about some of the cool technologies that get used in the art of shopper marketing, and occasionally about some of the great gadgets that are available for purchase when we do go shopping.

feeds.title: Kizer & Bender's Retail Adventures
feeds.description: Rich Kizer & Georganne Bender are professional speakers, retail strategists, authors and consultants whose client list reads like a 'Who's Who' in business. Companies internationally depend upon them for timely advice on consumers and the changing retail market place. Retail Adventures is an entirely new perspective on a retail blog. You'll find strategies, tactics, tips and techniques to help you grow your business!

feeds.title: Aislelabs Blog
feeds.description: Aislelabs is a technology company assisting retailers to increase sales through the power of big data analytics. Our mission is to transform retail locations to smart stores, resulting in effective marketing, increased sales, and better customer satisfaction.

feeds.title: ETP Blog
feeds.description: ETP is an Omnichannel Retail Solutions company headquartered in Singapore, serving market leaders in 22+ countries across Asia Pacific, India & the Middle East.

feeds.title: Intelligence Node Blog
feeds.description: Retail Intelligence is a place to enable your retail business with a data-driven pricing and merchandising strategy that has a direct impact on revenue and growth. Our blog covers a vast range of topics to maximize your retail growth and ensure your success. Blogs topics cover Retail strategy, retail sales, ecommerce, pricing strategy, merchandising, retail analytics, seasonal sales, supply chain, marketing strategy, consumer behavior, big data and AI.

feeds.title: Tokinomo Blog
feeds.description: Tokinomo blog covers hot retail topics such as shopper activation trends, grocery retail technologies and experiential marketing solutions for FMCG brands.

feeds.title: Retail Mavens Blog
feeds.description: As a former retail store owner, RETAILMavens founder Cathy Donovan Wagner learned how to master numbers to go from near-bankrupt to owning three successful multi-million dollar stores. Cathy now uses her cutting-edge expertise in retail and consumer behavior to help thousands of independent retailers increase sales and improve cash flow, using her proven Profit Breakthrough SystemTM.

feeds.title: Medallion Retail Blog
feeds.description: Medallion Retail is an established boutique agency that plans, creates, produces and supports signage and displays for big retailers and brands at retail.

feeds.title: Retailbound Blog
feeds.description: Retailbound offers retail coaching, retail consulting, and managed marketing assistance to manufacturers who want to sell their products to retailers. At Retailbound, we have a passion for retail, which enables us to provide the very best insights and solutions for you.

feeds.title: Lebensmittel Zeitung
feeds.description: German Retail Blog is powered by Lebensmittel Zeitung. LZ is an exclusive source of news & in-depth analysis providing full coverage of German & international marketing strategies, product ranges & retail formats.

feeds.title: GSP » Retail Marketing
feeds.description: GSP delivers site-specific, best-in-class retail graphics, design services and POP solutions to over 60,000 store locations throughout North America.

feeds.title: Shopify » Retail
feeds.description: A blog about retail marketing, running a brick-and-mortar store or market merchant business, and updates about Shopify POS.

feeds.title: Soult's Retail View
feeds.description: A blog written by retail consultant Graham Soult, Soult's Retail View gives a multi-perspective view of the retail industry, featuring insights from experienced retailers and updates on the UK retail industry.
